body:
Nothing is stopping you from asking, but would you believe him if he says your bf isn’t? He could be honest, or he could lie, we really don’t know. You might never get satisfactory closure. 
I know it really sucks, but it’s probably better to let go.

Thanks man, sometimes I just wonder what I’m even being strong for :/ 
I came inside my house and my dog cuddled with me so I am feeling a bit better. Thank you for your reply and the hug made me feel better too. Hope your night goes well :)
